steps: Mock the API response to return JSON without the 'owner' field
Call the function that accesses response.json()['owner']
expected_results: A KeyError is raised indicating the missing 'owner' key

optimized_test_suite.title: Open account with valid data
optimized_test_suite.description: Create a new account using valid input data and verify successful creation.
steps: Prepare a request payload with all required fields
Send a POST request to the open account endpoint
Check the response status and content
expected_results: Response body contains the newly created account details

optimized_test_suite.title: Open account with missing required field
optimized_test_suite.description: Attempt to open an account with a missing required field and verify appropriate error handling.
steps: Prepare a request payload missing a required field (e.g., 'email')
Send a POST request to the open account endpoint
expected_results: Response status code is 400 Bad Request
Response body includes a validation error for the missing field

optimized_test_suite.title: Boundary test for maximum payload size
optimized_test_suite.description: Send a request to the open account endpoint with payload size at the maximum allowed limit.
steps: Create a payload with fields populated to the maximum allowed length
Send a POST request to the open account endpoint
expected_results: Account is created successfully without truncation

optimized_test_suite.title: Open account missing owner field
optimized_test_suite.description: Ensure that a request missing the required 'owner' field raises a KeyError as identified in test_open_account edge case.
steps: Send a POST request to /api/banking/accounts with JSON payload {"opening_balance": 100} (owner omitted).
expected_results: Response status code is 422 (validation error) and the response body does not contain the 'owner' key, confirming the expected KeyError scenario.
